learningObjectives: Explain how horizontal mouse position maps to an oscillator frequency spanning 20 Hz to 10 kHz
Identify the single spectral peak that a pure sine oscillator produces in the FFT display

Relate the perceived pitch of the generated tone to the numeric frequency driving the oscillator
